original: Each source contributes its full length as eight little-endian u64 octets followed by every original operation octet, in collection order. The fingerprint is the raw sequence, not a digest substituted for that sequence.
source: Only the actual OperationSourceCollection provides count and immutable ByteSpan at an ordinal; no Vec compatibility implementation or flattening constructor.
output: Caller-owned OperationByteOutput receives exact original segments. An incremental hash output can absorb the same segments without constructing fingerprint/payload/hash-input owners; an owned output must retain its actual accepted prefix on refusal.
controls: Original source ownership remains unchanged through success and cancellation. The callback observes exact per-source octets and the complete length prefix; cancellation refuses a completed fingerprint capability. Cumulative ownership is never reset or refunded.
ids: child domain bytes, zero, original parent UTF8, zero, original slot UTF8, zero, the exact fingerprint, zero, ordinal little-endian u32. Invocation independently requires stable bytewise child-ID ordering and its exact parent/child separators; its sorting metadata remains caller-retained and is not covered by the child helper.
